entities.summary: Edward Sidney Aarons was an American writer who authored more than 80 novels from 1936 until 1975. One of these was under the pseudonym "Paul Ayres", and 30 were written using the name "Edward Ronns". He also wrote stories for detective magazines, such as Detective Story Magazine and Scarab.
